text:
maria: quick async check — procurement slate for next-week buildout. I have 12x A100 -> 8x H100 swaps on shipping manifest, customs ETA 72h for the H100s. Need owners to confirm: thermals, rack slots, reservation mapping to billing, and firmware window.

alex: thanks — procurement confirmed H100 manifest + 8 extra power harnesses. ETA at datacenter docks Tue 09:00 PT. shipping docs: AWB 1Z999AA10123456789.

raj: noted. customs hold usually takes 48-72h, will ping our customs broker. can we move 2x A100s to staging racks so we have immediate canary capacity?

maria: yes please move 2x A100 to staging (nimbus-03, nimbus-04). kim/raj — who owns thermal sign-off for those racks?

kim: I can own thermal sign-off for staging racks. I'll run the overnight burn and post temps. Plan: 4-hour soak with perf-runner and `sensors -j` capture.

jen: reservation side: we currently have 18 slots reserved in account:dedicated-us-west. If we swap SKUs we need to remap reservations — alex can you confirm reservation IDs?

alex: creating PR to reconcile reservation mapping and billing tags now — https://git.internal/x/repo/pulls/2345 (ops-bot will post CI). pinging @kim @raj for review.

ops-bot: CI started for PR #2345 — lint OK, infra-smoke queued.

raj: will review PR later this afternoon. quick question: do we have spare cable kits (2x 100Gb QSFP+, 2x PDUs) in staging inventory?

maria: inventory check: we have 1 spare QSFP+ kit and 1 PDU spare. procurement ordered 1 more PDU but it's separate line-item. if custom hold delays H100s we may need to reallocate PDUs from canary -> production.

kim: re: fallback plan — if H100s delayed >72h, we should fall back to mixed A100+LTQ quantized H100 replicas to keep SLOs for latency-sensitive endpoints. that requires a config tweak in routing policy (canary->fallback). I can prepare the route patch.

jen: firmware window needed for H100 arrival: proposed Wed 02:00-04:00 PT (low traffic). Need owners to ack for that window (will coordinate change control).

raj: ack for Wed 02:00-04:00 PT for firmware, pending power verification. I'll validate PDUs and breakers during EOD check. command I'll run: `./tools/power-check --rack nimbus-03 --pdu PDU2` and report.

alex: billing mapping: reservation IDs will be remapped by PR #2345. billing-bot will emit the mapping after merge.

billing-bot: Reservation mapping (pre-merge): reserved-18 -> account:dedicated-us-west (sku:A100). After merge: reserved-18 -> account:dedicated-us-west (sku:H100x8 + A100x10).

maria: outstanding owners/asks: 
- raj: confirm customs ETA and PDU verification by EOD
- kim: thermal soak + route patch for fallback by tomorrow morning
- alex: merge PR mapping + coordinate billing update
- jen: schedule change-control for Wed firmware window and notify oncall

raj: will push customs update by 16:30 PT. if broker confirms clearance earlier I'll flag.

kim: aiming to post soak logs + route patch by 08:30 PT tomorrow.

alex: will get PR reviewed and try to merge before EOD, pinging finance for final tag.

jen: I'll draft the change-control and add oncall rota, will share doc link when ready.

maria: perfect. if anyone hits a blocker callout here so we can escalate to platform leads. :thumbsup:

alex: quick heads-up — I pushed a small config comment in PR about quota mapping, @maria can you validate billing tag list?

maria: validated tags offline, they match reserved sku list. thanks.

raj: one more note — customs broker asked for serial numbers for H100s, alex can you share manifest CSV with SNs?

alex: uploading manifest with SNs to the shared drive now — link: https://files.internal/redwood/procurement/3765432100-manifest.csv

maria: thanks all. we'll reconvene async tomorrow. if customs clears earlier we may shift firmware window earlier.

kim: thanks — adding reminder to staging checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: firmware-window-notify -> Wed 01:30 PT (channel:eng-infra).

jen: noted, will escalate if PDUs are still short.

maria: end of thread — eod owners updated.
